_comment: ComfyUI Workflow C — Planet INTERIOR panoramas via the Flux Equirectangular 360 LoRA (Flux.1-dev base, trigger 'equirectangular 360 degree panorama'). Cloned from workflow_flux_360_planets.json; differs by hi-res 4096x2048 output, steps=40 and FluxGuidance=3.0 for richer interior detail, an 'interior view' positive prefix, and a 'panoramas/' save prefix. API-format graph: POST to /prompt as {"prompt": <this>}. Flux needs SPLIT loaders (UNETLoader + DualCLIPLoader + VAELoader), NOT CheckpointLoaderSimple. Replace [FACTION_SCENE_PROMPT] / [FACTION] / [CLIMATE] before queueing — see docs/design/ART_PROMPTS.md '### Planet Interior Panoramas (Flux 360 or SD1.5 360)'. Adjust unet/clip/vae/lora filenames to whatever is installed on the host.

_generation_notes.lora: flux_equirectangular_360.safetensors (civitai#735980, ver 823024), trigger 'equirectangular 360 degree panorama', weight 0.5-1.5 (default 0.85)
_generation_notes.base_model: Flux.1-dev — split loaders: UNETLoader (node 4), DualCLIPLoader T5+CLIP-L (node 11), VAELoader Flux ae (node 12). Distilled guidance set via FluxGuidance (node 13).
_generation_notes.latent_note: Node 5 is EmptySD3LatentImage — Flux uses 16-channel latents, so 'EmptyLatentImage' must be the SD3 variant or sampling errors on a channel mismatch. Size 4096x2048 = 2:1 equirectangular at panorama resolution. WARNING: 4096x2048 Flux sampling is VRAM-heavy on a 24GB RTX 4090; if OOM, render 2048x1024 then upscale 2x with an UltimateSDUpscale / model-upscale pass.
_generation_notes.sampler: KSampler (node 3): steps=40, cfg=2.5, euler/simple — more steps than the planet workflow (30) for interior detail. FluxGuidance guidance=3.0 (node 13) — higher than the planet workflow (2.5) to push scene structure. Drop cfg to 1.0 to ignore the negative and run ~2x faster.
_generation_notes.positive_prompt: Set node 6 text to 'equirectangular 360 degree panorama, interior view, [FACTION_SCENE_PROMPT]' from ART_PROMPTS.md '### Planet Interior Panoramas'. Negative (node 7) is fixed for all scenes.
_generation_notes.variants_target: 5 faction cities + 3 wilderness biomes = 8 panoramas minimum; change node 3 'seed' for additional variants
_generation_notes.naming_convention: <faction>_<biome>.jpg — consumed by PlanetScene -> PanoramaViewer; fallback is outlanders_city.jpg

_sd15_fallback._comment: No-Flux fallback for hosts without Flux.1-dev. Start from workflow_api.json (CheckpointLoaderSimple + KSampler), insert a LoraLoader (node 10 pattern from workflow_zit_nebula.json). Render small then iterative img2img upscale to reach the target panorama size.
_sd15_fallback.aspect: render 768x384 (2:1), then iterative img2img upscale 2x with denoise=0.35 to reach 1536x768
_sd15_fallback.ksampler: first pass steps=28, cfg=7.0, sampler dpmpp_2m, scheduler karras; upscale pass denoise=0.35

inputs.text: fisheye, text, watermark, latitude lines, grid, people, faces
